Published as sbox.game r427072 from sbox-cool/sbox-network-storage main ddf9b61 (every shipped file matches except *.sbproj, which the publisher rewrites). Adds batched analytics, encrypted requests v2 with signing-key pinning and uniform /api storage routes; the library sends single-event analytics when the server does not report the analytics-batch capability and keeps /v3 as its default root, so it keeps working on servers without these features.

Scoped native smoke, not a published package or full matrix: sbox-dev.exe 26.10.13a, engine build 38759734332. Clean restart with main b418aee plus branding and script-sync branches. Default Configure used /v3; earn returned granted=100, POST ping returned pong=true, analytics session join and heartbeat succeeded. Sync Tool connected, listed eight endpoints, displayed the new lime cube. Expected endpoint 409/404/401 were surfaced as HTTP_ERROR on this older server branch, which does not include #163. No PostgreSQL, hosted, Library Manager install or publish exercised. Package .version is stale; no package revision asserted.

Scoped native security regression, Steam sbox-dev.exe 26.10.13a build 38759734332, v2-required. All 12 assertions passed: correct signing pin; encrypted no-input POST; pin re-Configure invalidation and wrong-pin refusal after success; pin recovery; same-account sealed proxy input/response round trip; TOFU first use and persisted store; substituted signing-key/downgrade refusal; retained trusted config and a subsequent encrypted call. Proxy transport used a local delegate between the real client and host library paths, with a real HTTP backend; not a two-PC RPC test. No PostgreSQL, hosted backend, Library Manager installation or publish is asserted by this row.
